summary: BrenX Ltd. (formerly Brenmiller Energy Ltd.) filed a Form 6-K reporting a name change approved by shareholders on July 29, 2026, effective August 11, 2026. The registrant changed its name from Brenmiller Energy Ltd. to BrenX Ltd. and initiated a Nasdaq ticker change to BRNX, expected to start trading on August 14, 2026. The CUSIP remains unchanged, share certificates remain valid, and shareholder rights are unaffected. This is a routine corporate name change with no special-situation implications or deal terms.
